## Summary

Describe what this change does and why it is needed.

## Related issue or research question

Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Implementation details

- What changed?
- Which components or pages are affected?
- What assumptions does this change introduce?

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `node tests/check_studio_console.js`
- [ ] `node tests/check_corporate_site.js`
- [ ] Added or updated regression tests for new behavior.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and development log.

## Security and scope

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal information, customer data, or confidential details are included.
- [ ] Security implications and remaining limitations are documented.
- [ ] No production capability, certification, or deployment claim is made without evidence.
- [ ] Any real-tool integration enforces authorization at the actual tool boundary and includes isolated bypass tests.

## Reviewer notes

Call out known limitations, edge cases, and areas that need particular attention.
